Literature: Cautious Weight Decay (Chen et al., 2025, arXiv:2510.12402) reports lower training loss for AdamW and Muon LLM pretraining from sign-aligned decay masking with no throughput cost; the mechanism is optimizer-local and directly matches the existing train.py toggle name
expected_effect: Lower public val_bpb by 0.002 to 0.006 relative to the same-host pinned control (target <= 1.0037 on trn21 or <= 1.0039 on trn22) at a step count within +/-3% of the control (roughly 2010-2135 steps). Direction: decrease. Falsified if BPB is >= control at matched steps, or if step count drops more than 3%.
hypothesis: The pinned control applies ordinary decoupled weight decay to every Muon/AdamW-decayed coordinate regardless of whether the decay opposes or reinforces the current update. Cautious weight decay (mask decay to the coordinates where the update direction and the weight sign agree, i.e. decay only where shrinking is consistent with the optimizer's own descent direction) is an optimizer-only, elementwise change with no matmul/format/kernel footprint, so step rate should stay within a few percent of the 2071/2076-step controls, while the reduced fight between decay and update improves loss per step over a 1800 s budget. The ledger's confounded rows (batch-ramp 2397 steps/1.01219, BF16 norm-output 2716/1.01628, MLP-input 2346/1.0197) show that throughput gains without per-step quality are not wins; this proposal targets per-step quality at matched throughput, which is exactly the regime where the comparability gate (<10% step difference) permits a clean KEEP.
single_causal_change: Pass --cautious-wd only. Every other option stays at the 9a4caa7b defaults used by the two pinned controls: identical launch shape (NEURON_LOGICAL_NC_CONFIG=2, torchrun --nproc_per_node=4, --num-steps 5000 --max-train-seconds 1800 --seed 42, NEURON_CC_FLAGS='--optlevel=1'). No precision flag (--bf16-sdpa-input, --bf16-norm-output), no kernel flag (--nki-*, --compile-*), no other optimizer switch (--demon-beta1, --wd-decay-to-zero, --muon-lr-fp32, --tensor-lr-scalars, --adam-every-n-lr-comp), no architecture switch, no data/eval change. The weight-decay masking policy is the sole causal option.
